name: Gästehaus Waltraud
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Waltraud is a traditionally managed inn in the centre of Neustift in the Stubai Valley. Its prime location provides quick access to the valley stations of the mountain cable cars and local shops. The rooms are functionally furnished, each featuring a private bathroom and toilet. The property's amenities include a bright breakfast room and a relaxing terrace. A hearty breakfast is served right on site. The breathtaking surroundings of the Stubai Valley are perfect for scenic hikes and winter sports. Dedicated parking is available for guests.
